rendered.caption: Figure 21.1: Four elements help us examine a habitual action. The dashed learning arrow closes the circle at the cue to mean “when this cue appears again”: repetition and its consequences can shape the response it brings to mind.
rendered.alt: Four elements form a clockwise circle: cue, impulse, action, and outcome. Impulse means readiness to act and need not be conscious. A dashed arrow labeled Learning returns from outcome to cue, showing how experience can shape responding the next time the cue appears, rather than changing the cue itself.
